Experience Your Vacation Haven

A stay at Oceans 11 Oasis at Gulf Place Retreat doesn't only give you access to a beautiful property, but it also includes a private pool, 6 seat golf cart, a private driveway, and a secluded outdoor space. Did we also mention the property is within walking distances to the sugar white sands of the Emerald Coast? Have you packed your bags yet?

Just down the street from the Gulf Place Town Center and the emerald waters you’ve been dreaming of is Oceans 11 Oasis. This two story, single family home is designed to impress with coastal shabby chic style and high-end finishes. Enjoy the open concept 1st floor as you cook up a great meal on stainless steel appliances, enjoy dinner together in the dining area, or chill out together and watch a movie in the living room. However, the best part of this rental is just beyond the sliding doors! The fenced-in backyard features a built-in grill with counter space, covered patio for those sunny days, various seating options, and a private pool! You won’t have to go far to enjoy the Gulf weather in this outdoor sanctuary. Grill up a great meal, swim at any time of the day, and play games with your group as the sun sets over the Gulf shoreline.

Speaking of your group, in this home, everyone will have the space and comfort they need to enjoy their vacation. On the 1st floor, you’ll find the master bedroom featuring a king bed and flat screen TV, along with a beautiful en suite bath that will leave you feeling like royalty. It features double vanity sinks, a walk-in shower, and separate vanity. Your guests will also feel like a part of the royal family, as they will have the 2nd floor to themselves. Upstairs, you’ll find 3 guest bedrooms with flat screen TVs, 3 full baths for maximum comfort, and a built in bunkbed with full size beds in the hall for the kids/grandkids.

While the home has everything you need and so much more, you’re only a short walk or golf cart ride to the Gulf Place Town Center which features stellar food options and boutique shopping, along with the pristine beaches of the Gulf. Pack up your group and enjoy all that Gulf Place has to offer with the ones you love!

About the Community of Gulf Place on 30A
Tucked away between the pristine beaches of the Emerald Coastline is the community of Gulf Place on 30A. This coastal town has a laidback vibe with 19 miles of dedicated bike path to get around the area with ease. The neighborhood features high-end, single-family homes with dedicated outdoor space, private pools, and easy beach access. Check out the Gulf Place Town Center for an incredible selection of food and shopping options, along with one of the many state parks in the area. From food to fun, Gulf Place on 30A is the perfect coastal location for those looking to rest, relax, and enjoy all that Destin has to offer. Amenities such as golf, tennis, biking, boating, water sports & more are available locally at additional costs.
